content: dude a goose stole my sandwich
this goose keeps getting away
guys i captured the goose but he already ate my sandwich :(
guys the goose is back
he's wearing my sunglasses??
the goose just walked into a convenience store
he STOLE EVERYTHING
oh my goodness
the goose has been BANNED from three parks
he was somehow already banned from a fourth
someone asked the goose what he wants
he pointed at a sandwich
the goose has learned where i live
i never told him
the goose was elected treasurer
all funds have disappeared bro
the goose stole a traffic cone
nobody knows why
there are now two traffic cones
the goose is no longer allowed in the library
he kept moving the history books
the goose just walked past me
he smelled like my sandwich (which is still missing)
there was a mysterious briefcase on a park bench
the goose picked it up
i somehow feel less safe
the goose has hired a lawyer
the lawyer is also a goose
the goose is under investigation
he is leading the investigation
the goose was spotted entering a sewer
he emerged with a necktie
the goose has released a statement
"honk"
markets reacted immediately
the goose now owns a car
please do not ask where he got it
the goose has been missing for several days
never mind he was in the attic
the goose has become strangely interested in municipal zoning laws
the goose was denied access to a restricted area
he denied the denial
the goose has acquired a second goose
they are discussing something
the geese have stopped discussing something
this is somehow more concerning
the goose just paid for something with cash
where did he get cash
the goose has discovered spreadsheets
his productivity has increased by 400%
i found a note taped to my door
it simply read 'goose was here'
the goose is currently wanted in seven jurisdictions
he founded two of them
the goose has started a podcast
every episode is exactly one honk long
the goose has become self-aware
he claims this changes nothing
the goose has returned from the void
